legend.0: 0 trivial: Greeting, single-step lookup, minimal thinking required
legend.1: 1 easy: Short explanation or direct text rewrite
legend.2: 2 moderate: Standard multi-step reasoning, typical coding task
legend.3: 3 hard: Complex reasoning, non-trivial debugging, multi-constraint design
legend.4: 4 expert: Research-level proofs, deep architectural synthesis

legend.0: 0 casual: Creative or conversational answers where multiple styles work
legend.1: 1 loose: Informational text where minor inaccuracies have low impact
legend.2: 2 accurate: Facts, runnable code, or specific instructions that should work
legend.3: 3 exact: Math proofs, mission-critical systems, financial or legal exactness

legend.0: 0 none: Any capable small model answers equally well
legend.1: 1 slight: A larger model may provide better phrasing or formatting
legend.2: 2 clear: A larger model produces noticeably better reasoning and depth
legend.3: 3 large: A smaller model would very likely fail or hallucinate
